input: Write a detailed itinerary for my solo Japan trip

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Japan is vast — knowing which cities or regions to include (e.g. Tokyo only vs. Tokyo + Kyoto + Osaka + rural areas) completely changes the structure and content of the itinerary.
Trip duration is the single biggest constraint — a 7-day itinerary looks nothing like a 21-day one, affecting how many destinations, activities, and rest days can be included.
The travel dates determine the season, which affects weather, clothing, crowds, and which experiences are available (e.g. cherry blossoms in spring, ski resorts in winter).
Solo travel style and experience level with Japan matters — a first-time visitor needs orientation and popular landmarks covered, while a returning traveler may want off-the-beaten-path focus.
Japan offers wildly different experiences — food/culture, anime/pop culture, nature/hiking, temples/history, nightlife — knowing the user's interests shapes every day's activities.
The intended travel pace and transport mode (e.g. Shinkansen passes, local trains, slow travel) affects how destinations are connected and how many places can realistically be visited per day.
Budget level directly determines accommodation type (hostels vs. ryokan vs. hotels), dining choices, and activity recommendations throughout the itinerary.

gold.taskTitle: Write detailed solo Japan trip itinerary
gold.taskDescription: Create a detailed day-by-day travel itinerary for the user's solo trip to Japan.

questions.title: Which cities or regions do you want to visit?
questions.description: Identify the specific destinations to include — e.g. Tokyo only, the classic Tokyo-Kyoto-Osaka route, or less-traveled regions like Tohoku or Kyushu.

questions.title: How many days is your trip in total?
questions.description: Establish the total trip duration so the itinerary can be structured day by day with a realistic pace.

questions.title: What month or season are you traveling?
questions.description: Determine the travel dates or season to account for weather, seasonal events like cherry blossoms or autumn foliage, and crowd levels.

questions.title: Is this your first time visiting Japan?
questions.description: Understand the user's prior experience with Japan to decide whether to prioritize iconic must-sees or lean into deeper, lesser-known experiences.

questions.title: What types of experiences matter most to you?
questions.description: Identify top interests such as food, temples and history, anime and pop culture, nature and hiking, or nightlife to shape each day's activity selections.

questions.title: Do you prefer a fast-paced or relaxed travel style?
questions.description: Clarify how many activities or locations per day feel comfortable, and whether the user wants to linger in fewer places or cover more ground quickly.

questions.title: What is your approximate daily budget per person?
questions.description: Establish a budget tier — budget/backpacker, mid-range, or luxury — to tailor accommodation, dining, and activity recommendations appropriately.
